channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: One woman’s refusal
item.description: A Supreme Court case over Fed governor Lisa Cook’s refusal to resign could determine whether presidents can fire Jerome Powell, threatening Federal Reserve independence and the dollar’s stability.

item.title: Ronald Reagan’s imaginary enemy
item.description: A new Reagan biopic borrows the controversial fictional-narrator device pioneered in Edmund Morris’ “Dutch,” raising questions about credit, criticism and cinematic Reagan biographies.

item.title: Why NC is outperforming the nation’s soft landing
item.description: As the U.S. economy cools, North Carolina posts faster job growth, lower unemployment and big reserves, bolstered by a decade of tax reforms that critics once said would backfire.

item.title: Warbirds hosting national anthem tryouts
item.description: Wilson Warbirds will hold tryouts Feb. 21 for singers and instrumentalists of all ages to perform the national anthem at home games during the team's inaugural season.

item.title: Area Calendar, Feb. 14-15, 2026
item.description: Weekend area sports schedule for Feb. 14–15, 2026, featuring Barton College basketball, bowling, volleyball, baseball, softball and lacrosse, plus high school wrestling and MACAA JV basketball tournaments.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Tigers take first ECAC title in unbeaten fashion
item.description: Wilson Prep girls clinch their first unbeaten ECAC regular-season title with a 92-21 rout, while Community Christian teams prep for MACAA play with both JV squads reaching league finals.

item.title: Hunt girls outlast Fike in OT, 54-46
item.description: Deoni Artis scored 19 points, seven in overtime, as Hunt edged Fike 54-46 for a second straight OT win over the Demons, climbing out of the Big East girls basketball cellar.

item.title: Reversal of fortune: Demons stun Warriors to grab Big East lead
item.description: Fike ends a 17-game skid vs rival Hunt with a second straight win, 67-54, as freshman Ty’lik Taylor scores 25 and Daquavis Greene controls the paint to give the Demons sole lead in the 5-A/6-A Big East.

item.title: Barton announces president’s and dean’s lists for fall semester
item.description: Barton College named 107 students to the president’s list and 389 to the dean’s list for fall 2025, recognizing GPAs of 4.0 and 3.3 or higher.

item.title: New library books: Library adds new ‘Chicken Soup for the Soul’ book
item.description: Wilson County Public Library’s latest arrivals span adult fiction, nonfiction, young adult and children’s books.
